name: Locomotion Fixtures — Wrong On Purpose
_note: Every asset in here breaks `locomotion` rules deliberately, so the whole pack is expected to be refused. It cannot live under `fixtures/rig/` — `case_rig.gd` asserts that nothing in that root is refused, and it is right to. Each file's `_breaks` field lists the rules it is here to trip, and each part table is a minimal three-bone leg so the mistake under test is the only thing wrong with it.
